mapper.select: SELECT ti.video_node_id, ti.scene_id, n.asset_id AS asset_id, n.content_url AS fallback_url, shot.asset_id AS shot_asset_id, shot.content_url AS shot_content_url, master.asset_id AS master_asset_id, master.content_url AS master_content_url, NULL AS duration, ti.order_index FROM timeline_items ti JOIN nodes n ON n.id = ti.video_node_id JOIN scenes s ON s.id = ti.scene_id LEFT JOIN nodes shot ON shot.id = n.parent_node_id AND shot.node_type = 'SHOT' LEFT JOIN nodes master ON master.id = s.active_master_node_id AND master.node_type = 'MASTER' WHERE ti.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND n.node_type = 'VIDEO' AND n.is_confirmed = 1 ORDER BY ti.order_index ASC, ti.id ASC
